# Rational recognition and entropy at one ordinary source

**Full Collatz remains open.** Three parallel attacks and a joint ternary-coding argument produced a sharper finite rational recognizer, entropy constraints for one unchanged ordinary orbit, and an all-threshold obstruction to one proposed cycle-exclusion bridge. This checkpoint adds **15 public Lean statements**, separately scoped written proofs, independent in-session reviews, and reproducible exact controls.

**Published commit:** `afe6f4d1a661b377c9daa4623bdd732ba478386b`  
**Tree:** `fd437b38bffccd66022316647c7d4c889d6d4501`  
**Single parent:** `cb1ae1bb4af0c8d082e9ff466b9fe0c84932301c`

[Start here](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/afe6f4d1a661b377c9daa4623bdd732ba478386b/research/closure-round5-20261123/README.md) · [Source and literature pins](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/afe6f4d1a661b377c9daa4623bdd732ba478386b/research/closure-round5-20261123/SOURCES.json) · [Verification and review record](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/afe6f4d1a661b377c9daa4623bdd732ba478386b/reports/2026-11-23-closure-round5/README.md)

## Why this change

The preceding checkpoint supplied exact triadic stopping rigidity and finite ordinary examples that defeat a local-statistics collision argument. The new PR178 rational certificate and PR180 actual stationary-gap analysis made two further questions concrete: how much can a supplied rational decision budget be reduced, and what entropy does one ordinary source itself force?

This round refreshes the latest 30 updated PR metadata records and reads the relevant exact files at PR178 `c91b80a3156e640ad471cf30c47721145ae21eb1` and PR180 `7d4ad9f11d3d7a54c67b0c6cff4f13a2ab967161`. The previous 145-record inventory remains preserved; this is not presented as a new proof audit of every branch.

## 1. A linear-denominator rational recognition budget

For the shortcut map, supply an odd-denominator rational `a/q` and a positive original source `n`. Normalize the fraction and put `B=n*max(1,abs(a))`. The written theorem recognizes the specific equality `a/q=Omega(n)` within the state-clock budget

`K = 14*bl(B) + 60*q + 18.`

It follows the original integer and the signed numerator with literal opposite-parity tests. A mismatch rejects. At original 1, it accepts exactly when the current rational is 2. At a repeated small numerator, it accepts exactly when the original state also repeats. There are at most `K-1` ordinary transitions.

The two savings are:

- Before original 1, two consecutive large-numerator clocks contract `x*max(1,abs(w))` by at least a factor `7/8`, uniformly in q.
- Before a small signed value repeats, all small-value charges together cost at most `2*binom(2q,q)^2 <= 2*16^q`. Charging the whole trajectory avoids multiplying a worst excursion cost by the number of excursions.

The original-1 guard is necessary; an explicit countercontrol refutes the unguarded contraction.

For the different sufficient-prefix question, matching

`H = 15*bl(B) + 64*q + 19`

opposite parity tests forces original convergence to 1 or a repeated positive state. Its extra parity tail is retained. The exact recognizer can reject a repeated numerator with unequal original states immediately, which explains its smaller budget.

For `q=3^r*q0`, with `3` not dividing q0, `N=bl(n)`, and `L0=bl(max(1,abs(a),q))`, removing the three-part first gives

`K_mixed = 14*N + (15*r+14)*L0 + 60*q0 + 18.`

The reusable verifier chooses a proved budget and preserves the preceding stronger `3(r+1)` stopping bound for pure triadic candidates.

```bash
python -X utf8 -B research/closure-round5-20261123/verify_rational.py 3 -4 9 --include-trace
python -X utf8 -B research/closure-round5-20261123/verify_rational.py 3 -4 9 --strategy mixed
```

Both accept `Omega(3)=-4/9`. This CLI takes the literal denominator, not its exponent. Signed, zero and unreduced candidates are handled exactly.

**Boundary:** this decides one supplied rational. It does not decide whether a successful rational exists for every source, construct a universal denominator selector, or exclude arbitrary positive cycles. The clock bound is not a linear bit-complexity assertion.

**Formal scope:** eight Lean declarations prove the local contraction, charge product and numerical contradiction. Full visit/repetition accounting, parity decoding, recognition correctness and mixed-denominator consumption remain written proofs.

[Complete argument](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/afe6f4d1a661b377c9daa4623bdd732ba478386b/research/closure-round5-20261123/TRIADIC_CONSTRUCTION.md) · [Finite Lean core](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/afe6f4d1a661b377c9daa4623bdd732ba478386b/research/closure-round5-20261123/TriadicConstruction.lean) · [Verifier](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/afe6f4d1a661b377c9daa4623bdd732ba478386b/research/closure-round5-20261123/verify_rational.py) · [Independent recognizer review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/afe6f4d1a661b377c9daa4623bdd732ba478386b/reports/2026-11-23-closure-round5/RATIONAL_SOURCE_REVIEW.md)

## 2. The actual source forces entropy when its height is polynomial

Let one positive ordinary shortcut orbit be injective, let H_N be its actual prefix maximum, and let lambda be any stationary limit of its overlapping parity-word laws along a subsequence N_i. Entropy is measured in natural logarithms. The written theorem proves

`liminf_i log(H_Ni)/log(N_i) >= log(2)/h(lambda).`

A zero-entropy stationary limit forces superpolynomial prefix heights on the same subsequence. This parity version does not require ergodicity.

The finite arithmetic input preserves the original source: equal length-m parity words force original sources equal modulo `2^m`. Above the actual height precision every sampled word is unique, so its empirical entropy is exactly `log(N-m+1)`. Exact endpoint blocking gives

`H(P_N,m) <= ceil(m/k) * (N-k+1)/(N-m+1) * H(P_N,k).`

The growing m is used in this finite inequality before passing only a fixed-k law to the limit. No growing-depth convergence rate or independence of overlapping windows is assumed.

### Direct backward odd-gap theorem

For the exact actual backward-gap lift, let eta be an ergodic stationary limit, let `a=E_eta G <= ell=log_2(3)`, and let beta be the finite liminf exponent of the actual odd-prefix heights along the same subsequence. Then

`h(eta) >= a*log(2)/beta.`

Without ergodicity the weaker `h(eta)>=log(2)/beta` still holds. The proof handles countable-alphabet entropy continuity explicitly and allows loss of the first gap moment. It proves growing-window concentration through bounded truncation and fixed-window averaging in the required order. It does not silently set the limiting mean to ell.

**Formal scope:** seven Lean declarations define the actual shortcut and parity prefix and prove their full affine identity, source congruence, height injection, exact word-image cardinality and arbitrary-height multiplicity. Infinite entropy and stationary-limit statements remain written.

[Complete source-pressure proof](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/afe6f4d1a661b377c9daa4623bdd732ba478386b/research/closure-round5-20261123/FIXED_SOURCE_PRESSURE.md) · [Finite Lean core](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/afe6f4d1a661b377c9daa4623bdd732ba478386b/research/closure-round5-20261123/FixedSourcePressure.lean) · [Independent reconstruction](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/afe6f4d1a661b377c9daa4623bdd732ba478386b/reports/2026-11-23-closure-round5/ENTROPY_CYCLE_REVIEW.md)

## 3. No entropy-rate loss in the ternary coding at nonnegative drift

For an arbitrary ergodic stationary positive-gap process of finite mean at most ell, define

`A_i=G_1+...+G_i,  Z=sum_i 3^(i-1)*2^(-A_i) in Z_3,  mu=Z_*eta.`

The written theorem proves

`dim(mu)=dim_info(mu)=h(eta)/log(3)`

and

`H(G_1,...,G_m | Z mod 3^m)=o(m).`

At fixed gap count, total clock and complete carry, the word is unique. Nonnegative drift makes the typical full carry quotient subexponential while the clock range is linear. The resulting subexponential typical fibre count, combined with countable-alphabet Shannon--McMillan--Breiman, gives the lower dimension. A Radon--Nikodym martingale transfers restricted-measure bounds to the full measure in the required direction. The whole prefix cylinder supplies the matching upper bound, and Fatou yields the entropy identity.

No iid or mixing assumption is imposed. The related fixed-total carry mechanism in rStation Paper 9 is credited; its specified tilted-iid theorem is not represented as the arbitrary ergodic result proved here.

For the actual gap law in Section 2, the complete past affine identity identifies this same code with the original orbit's odd-time residue limit. Thus

`dim_info(mu) >= a/(ell*beta) > 0,`

and at critical mean a=ell, the lower bound is `1/beta`.

**Boundary:** this is a Shannon/local-dimension theorem, not an untrimmed order-two collision estimate. The omitted typical-set mass has no proved exponential rate. Polynomial height and ergodicity are retained assumptions, not established for every hypothetical escaping orbit. No infinite dimension theorem is claimed as formalized in Lean.

An exact critical mechanical gap law supplies the complementary control: it is ergodic and its ternary factor is nonatomic, but at depth m it occupies only m+1 residues and has collision at least `1/(m+1)`. A sparse symbolic quadratic-growth modification is excluded as a single ordinary orbit by the new entropy theorem.

[Full ternary proof](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/afe6f4d1a661b377c9daa4623bdd732ba478386b/research/closure-round5-20261123/TERNARY_INFORMATION.md) · [Independent ternary review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/afe6f4d1a661b377c9daa4623bdd732ba478386b/reports/2026-11-23-closure-round5/TERNARY_PRESSURE_REVIEW.md)

## 4. Arbitrarily large rational least-root gaps do not close the cycle argument

For the primitive circuit word `1^p 0^h`, retain

`D=2^(p+h)-3^p > 0,  C=3^p-2^p,  m=C/D.`

Its least proper gap above its least state is exactly `(m+1)/2`, and its fully reduced numerical denominator is

`q=D/gcd(D,C),  gcd(D,C)=gcd(D,2^h-1).`

For every prescribed floor B and denominator threshold Q, the written construction gives such a primitive legal rational cycle with all states and all proper least-root gaps above B, full reduced denominator above Q, and slope arbitrarily close to `log_2(3)` from above. Every proper prefix coefficient exceeds one, while the full coefficient is below one.

Therefore those geometric and coefficient hypotheses cannot force a small positive carry gap below D. The ordinary source condition remains decisive: every positive integer realizing the chosen finite word is `-1 mod 2^p`, lies above its rational fixed point and strictly descends. The construction is not an ordinary cycle and does not exclude all other cycle words.

[Complete circuit obstruction](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/afe6f4d1a661b377c9daa4623bdd732ba478386b/research/closure-round5-20261123/CYCLE_EXCLUSION.md) · [Principal reconstruction](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/afe6f4d1a661b377c9daa4623bdd732ba478386b/reports/2026-11-23-closure-round5/ROOT_REVIEW.md)

| Check | Observed scope |
|---|---|
| Fresh Lean build | Two unchanged dependencies, two new modules and audit; all five commands passed with warnings as errors |
| Axiom audit | All 15 new public declarations; only `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound` |
| Exact replay | Normal and `-O` passed with byte-identical output; ten final source hashes bound |
| Rational recognition | 36,501 exact candidate decisions across all three strategies; 515 independently convergent oracle sources |
| Denominator and contraction controls | 2,115 paired edges, 360 exact three-part reductions, 23,576 two-large-step checks, 64 binomial products |
| Actual-source controls | 77,686 affine word identities, 12,869 reversed-gap endpoint identities, 3,594 exact finite averaging inequalities |
| Complete carries | 6,884 positive compositions; retained total clock and full quotient; 7,126 finite fibre checks |
| Rational cycles | 22 legal primitive circuits, 482 complete rotated carries, 22 ordinary descents, four large closed-form fixtures |
| Review | Separate hash-bound in-session reconstructions, with source review distinguished from execution |

A nontrivial positive ordinary repeated-pair acceptance was not exercised. Large cycle fixtures were checked by exact closed forms, full gcd and whole-run divisibility; their long trajectories were not enumerated. Finite controls are not extrapolated to infinite conclusions.

### Exact published-checkout gate

After pushing, fetched the remote branch and created a fresh detached complete checkout of `afe6f4d1a661b377c9daa4623bdd732ba478386b`. Ran `python -X utf8 -B tools/validate.py` with its receipt outside that checkout. All five required commands exited zero:

1. `tools/check_integration_state.py`
2. `tools/check_review_integration.py`
3. `tools/check_review_integration.py --self-test`
4. `tools/test_integrity_portability.py`
5. `reports/prepublic-2026-09-05/integration-d/check_followup.py --self-test`

The published checkout contained **537 tracked files** and remained clean. All **23** source/report bindings, **44** older Lean bindings, **5** compiled-input bindings and **10** exact-input bindings matched. All **512** files from the parent checkpoint were byte-identical. Remote head, tree and single parent were read back.

The in-repository checkout receipt records the earlier clean local science checkpoint before its two final receipt files were added. The published-head gate includes those additions. Repository integrity is separate from mathematical verification.

## Continuity and next missing step

All **25 files** are additive. The [preceding round](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/afe6f4d1a661b377c9daa4623bdd732ba478386b/research/literature-round4-20261123/README.md), [whole-repository review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/afe6f4d1a661b377c9daa4623bdd732ba478386b/research/whole-repo-round3-20261123/README.md), earlier proof modules and frozen source identities remain intact. [PR182_BEFORE.json](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/afe6f4d1a661b377c9daa4623bdd732ba478386b/reports/2026-11-23-closure-round5/PR182_BEFORE.json) preserves the preceding description.

The clearest next target is a quantitative bound on the omitted mass, or on complete source/carry fibres, strong enough for the untrimmed collision estimate of the same ordinary law. The rational route independently needs a source-specific successful approximation that funds its own certificate. This checkpoint establishes neither closing implication.

The PR remains an open draft on its existing base.
